'''2009 US West Nationals Day 1 Joe Phillips DS Agents Of Black Sun''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Joe Phillips]] at [[2009 US West Nationals]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince|Ref2-D-agentsofblacksun.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
